title: Deep learning codesign for ultrasparse, high-performance optoacoustic imaging
authors: Xuyang Chang; Xiang Liu; Federico Villani; Quanyu Zhou; Tian Jin; Lin Tang; Luca Benini; Xosé Luís Deán-Ben; Liheng Bian; Zhenyue Chen; Daniel Razansky
matched_query: deep learning codesign ultrasparse optoacoustic imaging differentiable detector layout reconstruction
reasons: joint coded acquisition and reconstruction design
final version verified from the official Nature Sensors article page
summary_en: A differentiable hardware-algorithm codesign framework that jointly optimizes optoacoustic detector layouts and reconstruction networks. The learned circular and hemispherical arrays use only 0.8–12.5% of conventional detector counts while retaining strong spatial and temporal fidelity; the authors also demonstrate a 32-element low-cost handheld system with volumetric imaging at 2 kHz.
